title: Simple Note-Taking App
description: An application for creating, organizing, and managing notes efficiently.

features.name: Create Notes
features.description: Allows users to create new notes with text input.

features.name: Organize Notes
features.description: Provides functionality to categorize and organize notes for easy retrieval.

features.name: Search Notes
features.description: Enables users to search through notes using keywords.

features.name: Edit Notes
features.description: Allows users to edit existing notes.

features.name: Delete Notes
features.description: Provides the ability to delete notes that are no longer needed.

target_users: Individuals looking for a simple and efficient way to manage their notes.
